title: Exploring the cytotoxic effect and CDK-9 inhibition potential of novel sulfaguanidine-based azopyrazolidine-3,5-diones and 3,5-diaminoazopyrazoles.
authors: Husseiny, Ebtehal M; S Abulkhair, Hamada; El-Dydamony, Nehad M; Anwer, Kurls E
one_liner_zh: 该文研究磺胺胍基偶氮吡唑烷二酮类化合物的合成及其CDK-9抑制与抗癌活性，涉及小分子-激酶互作，与蛋白质-DNA互作及TF-DNA体系完全无关。
abstract: Regarding the structural analysis of variable effective CDK-9 suppressors, we record the design and synthesis of two new sets of sulfaguanidine-based azopyrazolidine-3,5-diones and 3,5-diaminoazopyrazoles with expected anticancer and CDK-9 inhibiting activity. In the designed molecules, the pyrazole ring and sulphaguanidine fragment were linked together for the first time through diazo linkers as they are expected to enhance the anticancer activity and CDK degrading interaction. All derivatives have been estimated regarding their cytotoxic activity toward three tumor cells where CDK overexpression has been reported (HePG2, HCT-116, and MCF-7). Among these, four derivatives VII, VIII, X, and XIII exerted potent cytotoxicity against the chosen tumor cells presenting IC(50) range equal to 2.86-25.89 microM. As well cytotoxicity on non-cancer cells and CDK-9 inhibition assay have been also assessed for these candidates to evaluate their selectivity indices and enzyme inhibition. The 3,5-diaminopyrazole-1-carboxamide derivative XIII showed a superior combined profile as cytotoxic with high selectivity toward cancer cells (HePG2: IC(50) = 6.57 microM, SI = 13.31; HCT-116: IC(50) = 9.54 microM, SI = 9.16; MCF-7: IC(50) = 7.97 microM, SI = 10.97). Accordingly, it has been chosen to evaluate its probable mechanistic effect both in vitro (via enzyme assay, apoptosis induction, and cell cycle study) as well as in silico (through molecular docking). Overall, this work introduces the 3,5-diaminopyrazole-1-carboxamide derivative XIII as a potent CDK-9 inhibitor candidate (IC(50) = 0.16 microM) that merits further investigations for the management of breast, colorectal, and hepatic malignancies.
abstract_zh: 关于可变有效CDK-9抑制剂的结构分析，我们记录了两组新型磺胺胍基偶氮吡唑烷-3,5-二酮和3,5-二氨基偶氮吡唑的设计与合成，这些化合物预期具有抗癌和CDK-9抑制活性。在设计分子中，吡唑环和磺胺胍片段首次通过重氮连接子相连，因为预期这能增强抗癌活性和CDK降解相互作用。所有衍生物均针对三种已报道CDK过表达的肿瘤细胞（HePG2、HCT-116和MCF-7）评估了其细胞毒性活性。其中，四个衍生物VII、VIII、X和XIII对所选肿瘤细胞表现出强效细胞毒性，IC(50)范围在2.86-25.89微摩尔之间。此外，还对这些候选物评估了其对非癌细胞的细胞毒性以及CDK-9抑制试验，以确定其选择指数和酶抑制能力。3,5-二氨基吡唑-1-甲酰胺衍生物XIII表现出优越的综合特性，具有高细胞毒性且对癌细胞具有高选择性（HePG2：IC(50) = 6.57微摩尔，SI = 13.31；HCT-116：IC(50) = 9.54微摩尔，SI = 9.16；MCF-7：IC(50) = 7.97微摩尔，SI = 10.97）。因此，选择它来评估其可能的机制效应，包括体外（通过酶测定、凋亡诱导和细胞周期研究）和计算机模拟（通过分子对接）。总体而言，本研究将3,5-二氨基吡唑-1-甲酰胺衍生物XIII作为强效CDK-9抑制剂候选物（IC(50) = 0.16微摩尔），值得进一步研究用于乳腺癌、结直肠癌和肝癌的治疗。
